package aiprompt_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/aiprompt"
)

const semanticExecutionKey = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

func TestClientInterpretsOnboardingSemanticThroughExactConfidentialContract(t *testing.T) {
	var calls atomic.Int32
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		calls.Add(1)
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, request.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential", request.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "semantic-token", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		require.Equal(t, "application/json", request.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
		var payload map[string]json.RawMessage
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload))
		require.ElementsMatch(t, []string{"idempotency_key", "template_code", "language_code", "variables"}, mapRawKeys(payload))
		require.JSONEq(t, `"`+semanticExecutionKey+`"`, string(payload["idempotency_key"]))
		require.JSONEq(t, `"teacher.onboarding-semantic.v1"`, string(payload["template_code"]))
		require.JSONEq(t, `"ru"`, string(payload["language_code"]))
		var variables map[string]json.RawMessage
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(payload["variables"], &variables))
		require.ElementsMatch(t, []string{"student_turn", "onboarding_state", "dialog_context", "semantic_stage"}, mapRawKeys(variables))
		var studentTurn map[string]json.RawMessage
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(variables["student_turn"], &studentTurn))
		require.JSONEq(t, `"Я начинающий"`, string(studentTurn["text"]))
		body := semanticExecutionJSON(semanticExecutionKey, false)
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = io.WriteString(writer, body)
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "semantic-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	got, err := client.InterpretOnboardingSemantic(context.Background(), validSemanticRequest())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int32(1), calls.Load())
	require.Equal(t, "ru", got.LanguageCode)
	require.Equal(t, 1, got.TemplateVersion)
	require.False(t, got.Cached)
	require.Equal(t, "Понял.", got.Result.Response)
	require.Len(t, got.Result.SlotCandidates, 1)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, got.Result.SlotCandidates[0].Slot)
	require.Equal(t, "basic", got.Result.SlotCandidates[0].CodeValue)
}

func TestClientReplaysOnboardingSemanticByCausalKeyAndDiscardsOpaqueExecutionID(t *testing.T) {
	var calls atomic.Int32
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		calls.Add(1)
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodGet, request.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/api/v1/prompts/confidential-executions/"+semanticExecutionKey, request.URL.Path)
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = io.WriteString(writer, semanticExecutionJSON(semanticExecutionKey, true))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "semantic-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	got, err := client.ReplayOnboardingSemantic(context.Background(), "  "+semanticExecutionKey+" ")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int32(1), calls.Load())
	require.True(t, got.Cached)
	// The domain result has no execution_id/provider fields by construction;
	// an opaque provider row identifier cannot become a causal AI ID.
	encoded, marshalErr := json.Marshal(got)
	require.NoError(t, marshalErr)
	require.NotContains(t, string(encoded), "opaque-provider-execution-row-42")
}

func TestClientMapsUnknownOnboardingSemanticReplay(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodGet, request.Method)
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
		_, _ = io.WriteString(writer, "private replay state")
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "semantic-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.ReplayOnboardingSemantic(context.Background(), semanticExecutionKey)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnknown)
	require.NotContains(t, err.Error(), "private replay state")
}

func TestClientRejectsMalformedOrMismatchedOnboardingSemanticResponses(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(string) string
	}{
		{name: "unknown root field", mutate: func(value string) string {
			return strings.Replace(value, `"cached":false`, `"cached":false,"unexpected":"x"`, 1)
		}},
		{name: "unknown nested field", mutate: func(value string) string {
			return strings.Replace(value, `"response":"Понял."`, `"response":"Понял.","unexpected":"x"`, 1)
		}},
		{name: "null candidates", mutate: func(value string) string {
			return strings.Replace(value, `"slot_candidates":[`, `"slot_candidates":null`, 1)
		}},
		{name: "null candidate list", mutate: func(value string) string {
			return strings.Replace(value, `"string_list_value":[]`, `"string_list_value":null`, 1)
		}},
		{name: "trailing JSON", mutate: func(value string) string { return value + ` {}` }},
		{name: "mismatched idempotency", mutate: func(value string) string {
			return strings.Replace(value, `"idempotency_key":"`+semanticExecutionKey+`"`, `"idempotency_key":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"`, 1)
		}},
		{name: "mismatched template", mutate: func(value string) string {
			return strings.Replace(value, `"template_code":"teacher.onboarding-semantic.v1"`, `"template_code":"teacher.response.v1"`, 1)
		}},
		{name: "mismatched language", mutate: func(value string) string {
			return strings.Replace(value, `"language_code":"ru"`, `"language_code":"en"`, 1)
		}},
		{name: "oversized response", mutate: func(value string) string {
			return strings.Replace(value, `"response":"Понял."`, `"response":"`+strings.Repeat("x", domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResponseMaximumRunes+1)+`"`, 1)
		}},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
				require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, request.Method)
				writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				_, _ = io.WriteString(writer, test.mutate(semanticExecutionJSON(semanticExecutionKey, false)))
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "semantic-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.InterpretOnboardingSemantic(context.Background(), validSemanticRequest())
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic)
		})
	}
}

func TestClientMapsOnboardingSemanticStatusSafely(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name       string
		status     int
		body       string
		retryAfter string
		want       error
	}{
		{name: "unknown", status: http.StatusNotFound, body: `{"error":{"code":"not_found"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnknown},
		{name: "capability disabled", status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable, body: `{"error":{"code":"capability_disabled"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticCapabilityDisabled},
		{name: "unavailable", status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable, body: `{"error":{"code":"unavailable"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnavailable},
		{name: "pending", status: http.StatusConflict, body: `{"error":{"code":"execution_in_progress"}}`, retryAfter: "7", want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticPending},
		{name: "conflict", status: http.StatusConflict, body: `{"error":{"code":"idempotency_conflict"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticConflict},
		{name: "unknown conflict code", status: http.StatusConflict, body: `{"error":{"code":"legacy_conflict"}}`, retryAfter: "7", want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticConflict},
		{name: "invalid", status: http.StatusBadRequest, body: `{"error":{"code":"invalid"}}`, want: domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic},
		{name: "provider output", status: http.StatusBadGateway, body: `{"error":{"code":"provider_output"}}`, want: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticProviderOutput},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
				if test.retryAfter != "" {
					writer.Header().Set("Retry-After", test.retryAfter)
				}
				writer.WriteHeader(test.status)
				_, _ = io.WriteString(writer, test.body)
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "semantic-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.InterpretOnboardingSemantic(context.Background(), validSemanticRequest())
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, test.want)
			require.NotContains(t, err.Error(), "provider_output")
			var conflict *domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticConflictError
			if test.name == "pending" {
				require.ErrorAs(t, err, &conflict)
				require.True(t, conflict.Pending)
				require.Equal(t, 7, conflict.RetryAfter)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestClientMapsLegacyTextConflictWithRetryAfterAsConflict(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.Header().Set("Retry-After", "2")
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusConflict)
		_, _ = io.WriteString(writer, "execution is still in progress")
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "semantic-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.InterpretOnboardingSemantic(context.Background(), validSemanticRequest())
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticConflict)
	require.NotErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticPending)
	var conflict *domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticConflictError
	require.ErrorAs(t, err, &conflict)
	require.Equal(t, 0, conflict.RetryAfter)
	require.NotContains(t, err.Error(), "execution is still in progress")
}

func TestClientRejectsUnboundedInputBeforeHTTPCall(t *testing.T) {
	var calls atomic.Int32
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		calls.Add(1)
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	input := validSemanticRequest()
	input.Variables.StudentTurn.Text = strings.Repeat("x", domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticTurnMaximumRunes+1)
	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "semantic-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.InterpretOnboardingSemantic(context.Background(), input)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic)
	require.Equal(t, int32(0), calls.Load())
}

func validSemanticRequest() domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest {
	return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest{
		AIExecutionID: semanticExecutionKey,
		LanguageCode:  "ru",
		Variables: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables{
			StudentTurn: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticStudentTurn{Text: "Я начинающий"},
			OnboardingState: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticOnboardingState{
				State: "draft", DraftVersion: 1, ProfileVersion: 2,
				AcceptedSlots: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot{},
				ActiveInteraction: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticInteraction{
					Kind: "question", UIKind: "text", PromptText: "Расскажите об опыте.", ExpectedSlots: []string{string(domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience)},
				},
			},
			DialogContext: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDialogContext{},
			SemanticStage: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticStage{Kind: "default", PriorCandidateSlots: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot{}},
		},
	}
}

func semanticExecutionJSON(idempotencyKey string, cached bool) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{
"execution_id":"opaque-provider-execution-row-42",
"idempotency_key":"%s",
"template_code":"teacher.onboarding-semantic.v1",
"template_version":1,
"provider_code":"openai",
"provider_model":"gpt-test",
"language_code":"ru",
"response_schema_code":"teacher.onboarding-semantic.v1",
"parsed_response":{
  "schema":"teacher.onboarding-semantic.v1",
  "response":"Понял.",
  "slot_candidates":[{"slot":"self_assessed_experience","code_value":"basic","text_value":"","string_list_value":[],"integer_value":0,"confidence_basis_points":9000}],
  "questions":[],
  "uncertainties":[]
},
"cached":%t,
"created_at":"2026-09-10T10:00:00Z",
"expires_at":"2026-09-11T10:00:00Z"
}`, idempotencyKey, cached)
}

func mapRawKeys(values map[string]json.RawMessage) []string {
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for key := range values {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	return keys
}
